checkedOccurrences.text: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

wikipediaActualReadJa: Wikipedia「List of minor biblical places」のIphtah-el節を実読し、Joshua 19:14・19:27、ゼブルンの北境、アシェル領との隣接、Khirbet Japhetへのprobably同定を確認。標題Iphtah-el（綴り違いJiphtah-el）で該当地点を対象とする。
geographyCheckJa: 谷の古代範囲と現代地形の一致は未確定。候補同定はWikipediaの二次的なprobably表現のみ。
